summary: Thumbnail of a free shopper's classifieds page: local display ads across the top, five columns of liners under grey bars, and a mail-in classified ad form taking the bottom third.

frame.footer: Classified ad form: paper logo, a ruled grid for one word per box, checkboxes for Standard / Bold / Headline / Photo Ad, deadline note.

units.notes: Word-per-box grid with price tiers marked along the rows.

notes: Only 340 px wide; layout readable, text not. The ad-form grid is the useful part (compare the coupon in cl-010).
